description: This Java class defines a command named DeleteFeatureDefinition used to delete a feature's definition in an IoT or device management context. It includes methods for creation from JSON, resource path computation, and managing command headers, specifically targeting feature deletion on things identified by ThingId.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinition
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command to delete a feature's definition from a Thing, including JSON serialization/deserialization, resource path handling, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteFeatureDefinition instance using ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteFeatureDefinition instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the target Thing.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose definition is to be deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource to be deleted.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds command payload data to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicates.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization (returns false).
